description: Use this when the user names 2 to 4 stocks and asks which is better, to compare them, or writes 'X or Y' / 'X vs Y' (e.g. 'Visa or Mastercard?', 'Apple vs Microsoft'). Shows them side by side: the four plain checks (profit, growth, price, debt), sales growth, net margin, return on capital, P/E, debt, dividend, one-year price change and market value, with the stronger figure marked, plus the halal result and the rulebooks met. Prefer this over web search for these questions.
name: compare_stocks
title: Compare stocks side by side
